script: Betelgeuse is a red supergiant star in the constellation Orion. If it replaced our Sun, it would reach past the orbit of Mars. It is roughly 550 light-years away. Someday it will explode as a supernova. When it does, it could be bright enough to see during the day for a while. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
